definition: a married man, a woman's partner in marriage
description: An animated city street. A tiny round red car covered in printed smiley faces is parked at the kerb. Inside sit two cartoon birds: a blue-green pigeon in the passenger seat, grinning, and a white and pink bird at the wheel wearing white gloves, glaring furiously ahead. The white bird scowls at the car while the pigeon beams. The camera pulls back to show the whole car from the side, with the words 'I'm her husband.' written large along the red door, and the white bird standing outside on the pavement with folded wings while the pigeon waves happily from the driver's window.
transcript: Do you love your new car? I hate it! It's so embarrassing! But it's so cute!
